---
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md,README.md"
---
# Documentation guidance

- Write in clear technical English.
- Distinguish `Agreed`, `Proposed`, `To validate` and `Implemented` accurately.
- Record architectural decisions, trade-offs, compatibility impact, validation evidence and risks.
- WIP documents in `docs/wip/` are not release promises.
- Do not claim Playwright–Azure Test Plans native association until verified in the target organization.
- When describing Dataverse controls, state locator assumptions and tested platform/control variants.
